rules.profile_scope: Characters.json, Profile.json and BestiaryData.json are separate files, not a single world snapshot.
rules.equipment_scope: Owner inventory is from PlayerStateRecorderComponent in the selected world. Positive grants in an uncertain active slot, diminishing returns or nested equipment require further application evidence.
rules.live_completeness: Saved modifiers filter SaveToDatabase and cannot prove all current owner stats. Persistent known subtotal is not complete current owner percentage.
